text:
Ava (Content): Draft ready — two hero options + a short benchmark line. Need a quick heatcheck and legal signoff on the latency figure.

Ava (Content): HERO 1: 'Build LLM features faster with predictable inference'
HERO 2: 'Lower inference cost and lock in predictable SLAs'
Benchmark line: 'In internal tests, Redwood achieved up to 3x lower median generation latency on long-context workloads.'
CTA choices: `Request demo`, `See benchmarks`, `Join waitlist`

Jules (Growth): Both angles work. Question: which CTA should map to which funnel? want to A/B hero copy + CTA.

Priya (Demand): Routing proposal: `Request demo` -> Sales SDR queue; `Join waitlist` -> Nurture list; `See benchmarks` -> send to benchmark drip. I'll confirm HubSpot list names.

Noah (Design): Hero comps ready for both takes. HERO 1 art: dev at desk + latency sparkline. HERO 2 art: cost stack + savings overlay. Can swap quickly once copy locked.

Liam (Ops): FYI on demo capacity — if `Request demo` drives bookings, limit immediate calendar availability to NA & EMEA; APAC goes to waitlist for now. Also suggest rate-limiting form submissions to prevent abuse.

Sam (Product): We need legal to vet the "3x" phrasing. Is that consistent across models / quantization levels? If not, change to 'up to 3x' or 'in our internal benchmarks'. Can someone ping legal? :eyes:

Ava (Content): Updated quick qualifier: 'In internal benchmarks, Redwood reduced median generation latency by up to 3x on long-context requests.' Short hero option: 'Up to 3x lower latency on long-context requests.'

Jules (Growth): Works for A/B. Plan: run a 7-day A/B test pairing (HERO 1 + Request demo) vs (HERO 2 + See benchmarks). Keep sample small for launch.

Priya (Demand): HubSpot form mapping — please use exact field names so Ops can route correctly:
```
hs_form_name: "launch_inference_demo_v1"
hubspot_owner: "SDR-Launch"
utm_source: "organic"
utm_campaign: "q2_inference_launch"
cta_label: "Request demo"
```

Liam (Ops): Routing rules I'll add: create lead in HS with tag `q2_inference_launch`, post to #sales-live, and clip booking links by region. Throttle: 1 submission/min per IP.

Sam (Product): Also add fallback copy for capacity: 'If sessions are full, you'll be added to our priority waitlist.' avoids overpromising.

Ava (Content): Final suggested hero block to send to design + legal: 
HERO (primary): 'Up to 3x lower latency on long-context requests'
Subhead: 'Ship LLM features with predictable performance and better unit economics.'
Primary CTA: 'Request demo' — secondary: 'See benchmarks'

Noah (Design): Figma files uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abc123 20 I'll switch hero image after final copy lock.

Sam (Product): @legal — can you confirm the qualifier language today? need signoff before EOD to hit the launch window.

publish-bot: Created card ML-187 on Marketing Launch board: "Hero copy + legal review" assigned to Ava (Content).

Jules (Growth): After legal thumbs, I'll set up the VWO experiment and wire CTAs to the HubSpot mappings Priya gave. Will post the experiment URL here when live. :rocket:

Ava (Content): Thanks all — queuing legal and preparing final doc for creative. Leaving thread open for any last CTA tweaks. :thumbsup:
